description: Find a song for an Instagram Reel, on an Instagram account connected with the new Instagram login (list_accounts shows supports.music: true for those accounts; others get an error saying to reconnect from the dashboard). Without query it returns songs popular on Instagram right now; with query it searches by song or artist. Returns up to 25 songs, each with audioId, title, artist and duration, plus a next cursor for more. The chosen song goes on create_post as platformSettings.instagram.music: pass its audioId, plus title, artist, durationMs and artworkUrl, with platformSettings.instagram.postType 'reel' and a single video. previewUrl is a short-lived link for listening to a song before choosing; it is for listening only and is not stored on the post.

accountId.description: Required. The Instagram account id (from list_accounts) the Reel will post to.

after.description: Optional. The next cursor from a previous search_instagram_music result, for more songs.

query.description: Optional. Song title or artist to search for. Leave it out for popular songs.

name: search_instagram_music
title: Search Instagram Music
